<!-- 10. Hero photo on news articles (23 Oct 2026)
     Display only. Each article's featured image (the photo already chosen for its news card) is shown
     between the headline and the standfirst, framed as a 3:2 landscape at photo width.
     Skipped when the article already opens with a photo. Where the featured image is only the blank
     placeholder left by the old site, the article's first photo is used if it is at least 700px wide
     (checked against the framing data when the page doesn't say).
     Framing: eyes found by face detection sit on the top-third line; with no faces, the author's focal
     point is centred. Data: github.com/stephengardner1/belgrave-harriers-data (hero-framing.json).
     Tapping opens the whole, uncropped photo. -->
<style>
.BlogItem .bh-hero{order:3;margin:0 0 28px !important;padding:0 !important;max-width:850px;width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:3/2;overflow:hidden;background:#f5efe4}
.BlogItem .bh-hero img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 30%}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var article=document.querySelector('.BlogItem');
  if(!article)return;
  var layout=article.querySelector('.sqs-layout');
  if(!layout)return;
  var first=layout.querySelector('.sqs-block');                 // already opens with a photo
  if(first&&/sqs-block-(image|gallery)/.test(first.className))return;
  var meta=document.querySelector('meta[property="og:image"]');
  var src=meta&&meta.getAttribute('content')||'';
  src=src.replace(/^http:/,'https:').split('?')[0];
  // a real featured photo is stored with the news posts and has a filename
  if(src.indexOf('/5deec20d5aff607e8c14cbf2/')<0||/\/$/.test(src)){
    // older articles whose featured image is a blank placeholder: use the first photo in the article,
    // if it is big enough to be shown wide
    src='';
    var p=layout.querySelector('.sqs-block-image img, .sqs-block-gallery img, .sqs-html-content img');
    if(p){
      var dim=(p.getAttribute('data-image-dimensions')||'').split('x');
      var u=(p.getAttribute('data-image')||p.getAttribute('data-src')||p.src||'').split('?')[0].replace(/^http:/,'https:');
      // size known on the page: use it; not known (older inline photos): show it, then confirm
      // against the framing data and withdraw it if the photo is too small to be shown wide
      if(u&&!/\/$/.test(u)&&(!dim[0]||+dim[0]>=700)){src=u;var check=!dim[0]}
    }
    if(!src)return;
  }
  var slug=location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'').split('/').pop();
  var title=article.querySelector('.BlogItem-title');
  var box=document.createElement('figure');
  box.className='bh-hero sqs-block-image';
  var img=document.createElement('img');
  img.src=src+'?format=1500w';
  img.setAttribute('data-image',src);
  img.alt=title?title.textContent.trim():'';
  img.decoding='async';
  box.appendChild(img);
  if(check)box.style.display='none';        // shown once confirmed, so nothing jumps if withdrawn
  layout.parentNode.insertBefore(box,layout);

  var spec=null; // {e:[x,y]} eyeline, or {c:[x,y]} centre point
  function frame(){
    var w=img.naturalWidth,h=img.naturalHeight;if(!w||!h)return;
    var p=spec&&(spec.e||spec.c),eyes=!spec||!!spec.e;
    var fx=p?p[0]:0.5, fy=p?p[1]:(h>w?0.30:0.40);              // no data yet: where eyes usually sit
    var H=h/w,Hc=2/3,Wc=(w/h)/1.5,py=50,px=50,target=eyes?Hc/3:Hc/2;
    if(H>Hc)py=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(fy*H-target)/(H-Hc)))*100;
    if(Wc>1)px=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(fx*Wc-0.5)/(Wc-1)))*100;
    img.style.objectPosition=px.toFixed(1)+'% '+py.toFixed(1)+'%';
  }
  img.addEventListener('load',frame);
  fetch('https://stephengardner1.github.io/belgrave-harriers-data/hero-framing.json')
    .then(function(r){return r.json()})
    .then(function(d){spec=(d.items||{})[slug]||null;
      if(check&&(!spec||spec.small||!spec.u)){box.parentNode&&box.parentNode.removeChild(box);return}
      if(check)box.style.display='';
      frame()})
    .catch(function(){if(check&&box.parentNode)box.parentNode.removeChild(box)});
})();
</script>

      return {asset:p.slice(-2).join('/').toLowerCase(),file:f.toLowerCase()}};
    var fk=key(src);
    var dup=[].slice.call(layout.querySelectorAll('img')).some(function(i){
      var k=key(i.getAttribute('data-image')||i.getAttribute('data-src')||i.getAttribute('src'));
      return k.asset===fk.asset||(!!fk.file&&k.file===fk.file)});
    if(dup)return;
  }
  var slug=location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'').split('/').pop();
  var title=article.querySelector('.BlogItem-title');
  var box=document.createElement('figure');
  box.className='bh-hero sqs-block-image';

    var H=h/w,Hc=2/3,Wc=(w/h)/1.5,py=50,px=50,target=eyes?Hc/3:Hc/2;
    if(H>Hc)py=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(fy*H-target)/(H-Hc)))*100;
    if(Wc>1)px=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(fx*Wc-0.5)/(Wc-1)))*100;
    img.style.objectPosition=px.toFixed(1)+'% '+py.toFixed(1)+'%';
  }
  img.addEventListener('load',frame);
  fetch('https://stephengardner1.github.io/belgrave-harriers-data/hero-framing.json')
    .then(function(r){return r.json()})
    .then(function(d){spec=(d.items||{})[slug]||null;
      if(check&&(!spec||spec.small||!spec.u)){box.parentNode&&box.parentNode.removeChild(box);return}
